summary: One distinct CC BY 4.0 dark-wood single door from the two-style pack passes 5.0; D2 is a texture-only geometry duplicate and is excluded. Robot/expert qualification remains pending.

component_review.frame: Fixed collidable source components [13,14,15,16,17,18], including strike plate 14 and hinge parts.
component_review.panel: Collidable slab 3, long edge plate 5 and moving hinge parts 6,7,9,10.
component_review.handles: Collidable lever/plate components [0,1,2,8,11,12] on both sides.
component_review.unlatched: Only projecting latch tongue component 4 keeps visual and loses collision.

modifications: Select the original D1 frame and closed leaf from the CC BY USDZ; exclude the identical-geometry D2 material variant and two display preview meshes. Preserve original download and maps.

Apply proper Y-up to Z-up rotation, uniform 0.743 overall scale and 180-degree scene-facing choice that opens toward the modeled hinge front; no reflection. Center the modeled frame opening at the floor.
Place the ideal right-hand revolute axis at the two modeled hinge barrels near the hinge-side opening face; this is an inferred simulation axis.

Partition the source U-frame at the measured jamb/header planes and the x=-0.011 m rebate transition. The leaf back face is at x=-0.0107 m, just ahead of the source rebate lip; preserve the intact source profiles and all frame collision.
Begin closed and already unlatched. Keep the projecting latch tongue visual, exclude only its collision; retain leaf, handles, edge plate, frame, strike plate and hinge collisions.
Represent source hinge bearings and their local unrelieved jamb seat through reviewed collision-pair filters; all hardware colliders remain present and all unlisted contacts remain enabled.

The source slab has about 2 mm per side at the front jamb, but its sweep contacts the fixed strike plate after 0.5 degree and a 0.4% fit still contacts at 1.7 degrees. A measured 1.3% uniform Panel/Handle fit about the leaf width center, hinge-face depth and floor retreats each side by about 5.44 mm, preserving the centered floor-aligned opening. Verify the complete sweep, appearance and physics; this is a bounded simulation clearance repair, not manufacturer dimensions.
limits: D1 and D2 differ in material, not door/frame geometry; one identity counted.
The 1.3% fit, inferred ideal hinge and local filtered hinge/jamb contact are simulation approximations; the source has no hinge mortise.
The 54.2-degree isolated geometry stop is carried forward; no robot or expert qualification has run.
